task: Adopt conservative automatic cleanup for same-repository branches after pull requests are merged

events.summary: Scoped cleanup to the exact head branch of a merged same-repository pull request; default, fork, open, and closed-unmerged branches are excluded
Portfolio branch audit found merged and generated feature branches retained after PR completion
Added a pull_request closed workflow with an explicit merged-state, same-repository, and non-default-branch guard before deleting the exact encoded head ref
Workflow guard is fail-closed: deletion job is ineligible unless merged is true, the head repository equals the current repository, and the head ref differs from the default branch
The workflow uses only contents write permission and deletes only the exact URL-encoded merged pull-request head ref; it contains no branch-age or wildcard deletion path
Future same-repository merged PR branches are eligible for exact-ref cleanup while unpublished or unmerged work remains preserved
Branch hygiene is automated with conservative merged-PR proof rather than branch age or ancestry heuristics
